empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit it.

config.title: Configuration
config.snapshotNote: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}
config.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill "{name}"? {count, plural, =0 {No agent uses it.} one {1 agent uses it and will lose it.} other {# agents use it and will lose it.}} This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameRule: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (max 64 characters).
fields.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: what the agent must do.
fields.descriptionTooLong: The description is at most {max} characters.
fields.bodyTooLong: The body is at most {max} characters.
fields.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what the agent must check…

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

stats.noUsageBody: This skill isn't linked to any agent. Link it on an agent's Skills tab to start using it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.explain: Every save that changes the body writes a snapshot. Restoring an old version saves its body as a new version.
versions.diffEmpty: No differences from the current body.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a block of instructions an agent adds to its prompt.

import.title: Import a skill from a file
import.subtitle: A .md file or a .zip with a SKILL.md. Nothing is saved until you click Save skill.
import.trustWarning: An imported skill is somebody else's instructions inside your agent's prompt. Read the body before you save it.
import.unreadableTitle: Front matter keys that could not be read
